description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy_Proprietary, which extends the functionality of HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy by adding proprietary fixes related to HTML table background attributes and height settings.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy_Proprietary
classes.description: A class extending HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy that adds proprietary fixes for handling background attributes and height for table-related HTML elements.

methods.name: makeFixes
methods.description: Creates and returns an array of attribute transformations for background and height attributes on table-related HTML elements.
